meanings.meaning: Cutting off the foreskin, the skin covering the tip of the penis. God gave this as a sign of His promise to Abraham's family, done to boys at eight days old.
A name for the Jewish people, who were circumcised, as opposed to the Gentiles, called "the uncircumcision." Some cards use it for a group who held to this practice.
A picture of a clean heart, changed inside by God's Spirit, and not only a mark on the body. It means turning away from sin.
In Philippians, the name for people whose hearts are made clean by God's Spirit, those who truly belong to Him, whether or not they are marked on the body.
